selected.review: Vraie orientation latérale à droite. Tête et dos voûtés, deux bras et deux jambes distinguables, les deux pieds et le couteau étroit sont entiers. Aucun décor ou acteur secondaire.
selected.limits: Pose et côté caché reconstruits depuis deux rendus du même modèle frontal ; détails du visage, doigts et texture à comparer à une capture commerciale. Ne représente pas le Mumbler PAL. Décalage vertical des pieds lié à la perspective, ancrage sur la semelle la plus basse. Marge minimale lisible 56 px (4,47 %) ; pixels alpha 1 résiduels au bord. Native pixels unchanged. One static drawing; no source timing or 1:1 fidelity certified. RGB under alpha zero is invisible in ordinary composition.
selected.prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body transparent-background raster sprite of the fictional nonhuman Grey Child creature from the ORIGINAL Silent Hill (1999), Japanese/North American PS1 version, using the two supplied original model renders as the sole design authority. This is a new dedicated RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE for a side-view fighting game: head, torso, pelvis and legs turn toward the right edge, with the nose/face axis in profile; a small amount of depth is allowed only to separate the far limbs. Preserve the native small hunched proportions, mottled dark green-grey creature surface, elongated smooth tapered head with shallow indistinct facial slits, hunched high shoulders, two long bent arms, and two short bent legs. Exactly one narrow knife is held in its RIGHT hand, entire handle, blade and tip visible; maintain the narrow native blade rather than a cleaver. Quiet hunched ready stance, both complete feet visible and resting on one invisible ground line, weight plausibly supported, free hand visible forward. Faithfully reconstruct the same game creature from this new viewing direction; do not redesign it as the PAL Mumbler or film creature. One subject only, entire anatomy and knife inside the frame with generous clean margins; no contact shadow, background, floor, second view, text, HUD or labels. Preserve source surface detail without adding blood, victims, injury, or sexual detail. True transparent alpha outside the subject; alpha must remain transparent rather than a checkerboard. Native crisp detailed game-model-style rendering, diffuse neutral illumination suitable for compositing. Prefer a square canvas, complete subject occupying about 70–78% of image height.

selected.review: Profil orienté vers la droite avec faible ouverture du thorax pour distinguer les deux grands bras. Tête, mains, masse frontale et racine inférieure entière. Aucune jambe de marche, décor ou sac de boss ajouté.
selected.limits: Transposition latérale du rendu natif de la configuration suspendue ; le modèle isolé ne documente pas la totalité des attaches à la salle. Aucun support supérieur non observé ajouté. Ce PNG ne prouve ni animation de suspension ni transition vers la seconde phase au sol. Marge minimale lisible 19 px (1,52 %) ; silhouette complète sans coupe. Ancrage bas = extrémité de la racine, pas un appui inventé. Native pixels unchanged. One static drawing; no source timing or 1:1 fidelity certified. RGB under alpha zero is invisible in ordinary composition.
selected.prompt: Create ONE isolated complete transparent-background raster sprite of Sepulcher from Silent Hill: Homecoming (2008), following the supplied ORIGINAL final character render as the exact design authority. This asset depicts the suspended first-phase creature configuration only, in a dedicated RIGHT-FACING LATERAL SIDE VIEW for a side-view game. Head and thorax face the right edge; rotate the same model rather than retaining a front-facing portrait. Keep its elongated feature-poor head, dark mottled muted brown surface, large upper torso, exactly TWO exceptionally long arms and their full heavy hands, the attached frontal organic mass, and the complete tapering root-like lower extension from the native render. The far arm may be displaced slightly for readability but must remain connected to its own shoulder. Every fingertip and the entire root tip stays within generous transparent margins. Preserve all own body supports visible in the source; do not invent any unseen upper suspension apparatus. Keep the native suspended vertical relationship of the torso and lower mass: no added human walking legs, no feet, no second-phase crawling pose or phase transition. This is the creature alone: no Grand Hotel architecture, books, glass, hanging arena sacs, tree, ceiling, extra body, target, attack effect, shadow, floor, text or HUD. No added injury or blood. Detailed faithful game-model-style raster with restrained neutral lighting, source colors and surface texture. True transparent alpha background, no opaque rectangle/checkerboard. Prefer a square canvas and complete silhouette about 75–80% of image height; profile must read clearly when composed facing an opponent on the right.
